title: Clinic List Price Schedule for Wellness Plan Services
content:
Under the Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans, an included service is valued at the clinic list price on the service date. That is the price each redemption records, and it is the price used to value included services when a plan is settled.

## List prices by plan (USD)

| Service | Puppy | Kitten | Adult Dog | Adult Cat | Senior Dog | Senior Cat |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wellness exam | 64.95 | 64.95 | 64.95 | 64.95 | 69.95 | 69.95 |
| Core vaccine, per dose | 34.95 | 34.95 | 34.95 | 34.95 | 34.95 | 34.95 |
| Blood panel | 0.00 | 0.00 | 129.95 | 129.95 | 189.95 | 189.95 |
| Dental cleaning | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 349.95 | 349.95 |
| Fecal test | 39.95 | 39.95 | 39.95 | 39.95 | 39.95 | 39.95 |
| Sick-pet office visit | 59.95 | 59.95 | 59.95 | 59.95 | 59.95 | 59.95 |

## Footnotes

- The valuation basis is the same for all six plans: the clinic list price on the service date.
- The vaccine price is per core vaccine dose, so two doses given on one visit are two list values of 34.95 each.
- The wellness exam carries a list price of 69.95 under the Senior Dog and Senior Cat Wellness Plans and 64.95 under the other four plans.
- A blood panel is listed at 0.00 under the Puppy and Kitten Wellness Plans, and a dental cleaning at 0.00 under the Puppy, Kitten, Adult Dog and Adult Cat Wellness Plans.

## Illustration (hypothetical visit)

A hypothetical Adult Dog Wellness Plan visit at which a wellness exam, one fecal test and two core vaccine doses are redeemed records list values of 64.95, 39.95, 34.95 and 34.95, a total of 174.80 in list value for that visit. The same visit under the Senior Dog Wellness Plan records 69.95 for the exam, a total of 179.80.
